topics.title: Fractions: Addition & Subtraction
topics.description: Add and subtract fractions with like and unlike denominators, including mixed numbers and word problems.
topics.standard_title: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators

easy.description: Like denominators up to 12, simple fraction addition and subtraction

medium.description: Unlike denominators with small common multiples (halves, thirds, fourths, sixths)

hard.description: Mixed numbers and subtraction with regrouping

topics.title: Decimals: Place Value & Operations
topics.description: Add, subtract, and multiply decimals to hundredths using place value reasoning.

easy.description: Tenths place addition and subtraction without regrouping

medium.description: Tenths and hundredths addition and subtraction with regrouping

hard.description: Decimal subtraction with trailing placeholder zeros and mixed digits

topics.title: Scaling & Multiplicative Reasoning
topics.description: Compare quantities multiplicatively and understand scaling factors.

easy.description: Whole number scaling by factors of 2, 3, or 5

medium.description: Two-digit ratio terms with integer scaling factors

topics.title: Geometry: Area, Perimeter & Volume
topics.description: Calculate area and perimeter of 2D shapes and volume of rectangular prisms.
topics.standard_title: Relate volume to multiplication and addition

easy.description: Rectangle and square perimeter and area with whole number sides

medium.description: Triangle and rectangle area with fractional or decimal dimensions

hard.description: Composite shapes, missing dimensions, and perimeter vs area distinction
